about: The tool returns at once. ok true means the owner is being rung; how it ends arrives later as a transfer_outcome frame. ok false is a refusal: status is refused when the model should not offer a person at all, and unavailable when a person cannot be reached and a message should be offered instead. reason comes from a closed set and is never text from the call or from the host. The instruction member is fixed, model-facing text and is informative: OAIY passes the whole output to the model and does not depend on its wording.

output.instruction: The owner is being rung. Say one short line, then keep the caller company: ask what it is about and take a message if they want to leave one. Do not say the call is transferred, connected or on hold until you are told.

notInTheDesignDraft.plan_unavailable: The host did not answer the ring plan in time, or answered something unusable. Nobody is rung: a host that cannot say who may be rung is not a reason to ring everyone.
notInTheDesignDraft.call_changed: The call, or the AI's hold on it, changed while the request was being made. Nothing was done.

refusals.name: every device is set to do not disturb
the host is off, slow or unusable
the AI may not start a transfer itself

toolRefusals.about: Not transfer results: a tool call the plugin cannot run right now is completed ok false with only an error code, and the call carries on.

cases.name: a second slot tool while one is in flight
the 25th tool call of a call
